entities.title: Engine
entities.summary: The pure game: the hive, its dives, the ship, scoring, turns, recording and replay.
entities.purpose: Plays a game of Hivestorm frame by frame (1/60 s) with no DOM, timers or randomness of its own, so the page, the tests and the Worker all get the same game from the same seed and controls.
boundaries: Only + − × ÷ and exact helpers (Math.abs, sign, round, floor, min, max), with its own dsin and dcos for angles; random numbers only from rng.ts.
Knows nothing of the page, the network or the database: the page draws it and the Worker replays it.
